game.title: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
game.blurb: First-person survival horror game from Capcom, released 2017-01-23. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From the trip to Louisiana through the guest house, the yard, the old house, the family home and the ship, to both endings.

chapters.title: Survival Basics
chapters.summary: Doors, guarding, examining items, lock picks, shadow plinths, psychostimulants, bigger bags and Chem Fluid crafting.

chapters.title: Fighting the Family
chapters.summary: Knife finishes, multi-kills, Remote Bombs, and dealing with Marguerite and Jack.

chapters.title: Videotapes, Coins, Files and Statuettes
chapters.summary: The videotapes and their challenges, Antique Coins, files and the Mr. Everywhere statuettes.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Easy, Normal and Madhouse, the under-4-hours run, and runs with few Item Box visits or First Aid Meds.

chapters.title: Extra Modes
chapters.summary: Nightmare, Night Terror, Bedroom, Ethan Must Die, 21, Daughters and Jack's 55th Birthday.

chapters.title: End of Zoe
chapters.summary: Finishing End of Zoe on each difficulty, the no-weapons run, the Extreme Challenge, fist combos and stealth kills.

chapters.title: Not a Hero
chapters.summary: Finishing Not a Hero on Easy or Normal, and on Professional.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 418370; its schema names the game "RESIDENT EVIL 7 biohazard / BIOHAZARD 7 resident evil". RAWG's search also lists "Resident Evil 7: Biohazard - Not A Hero" and a teaser as separate entries, which were not used. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only its "Table of Contents" subpage is written, and the Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls pages it links are not, so nothing was used. residentevil.fandom.com has a "Resident Evil 7: Biohazard" page with about 212 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 58 Steam achievements is hidden, so no chapter is spoiler-guarded by default; the story chapter names places (the guest house, the old house, the ship) from the achievement text. The extra modes (Nightmare, Bedroom, 21, Daughters and so on), End of Zoe and Not a Hero each have achievements, so they get their own chapters; the data does not say how each one is bought or unlocked.
